schema.states: Alphabetical array. state.name matches the existing location selector; code is an app short code and is not presented as a certified current ISO list.
schema.cities: Alphabetical array per state. name is the stored canonical display value; aliases supports legacy-name search. id is one upstream ID; sourceIds preserves IDs combined for identical labels within a state. Distinct places sharing the same city name and state are intentionally one form option.
schema.search: Compare both name and aliases after Unicode normalization and case folding. Return city.name as the canonical value. Reject city/state combinations absent from that state.

transformations: Extracted only India from the pinned upstream file.
Kept all 28 states and 8 union territories, including merged Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu.
Removed coordinates, populations, unrelated country fields, and county IDs; preserved source city IDs.
Fixed six state assignments using government sources.
Removed explicit District/Division records and other unmistakable administrative-only or generic labels. This is conservative, not a full gazetteer classification.
Collapsed duplicate display labels within a state and the duplicate Prayagraj label.
Normalized selected renamed cities and added common legacy-name search aliases.
Sorted states and city labels alphabetically.

Bangalore and Bengaluru refer to the same city.
Karnataka city renamings; modern Mysuru spelling retained from upstream.
Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar / Aurangabad and Dharashiv / Osmanabad.
Mahe and Yanam belong to Puducherry; they are enclaves surrounded by other states.
Mahe is part of Puducherry, not Kerala.
Paralakhemundi belongs to Odisha, not Andhra Pradesh.
Kausani, Mukteshwar and Munsiyari belong to Uttarakhand, not Uttar Pradesh.

distribution: Keep this attribution and ODbL license with redistributed copies. Publish the adapted JSON/provenance under ODbL 1.0 alongside any public selector that redistributes it, and link the source/license from a data-credit notice. The license covers this location database, not unrelated app source or private enquiry records.
limitations: A broad community-maintained city/town/locality selector, not a certified census or exhaustive register of every Indian settlement.
Some upstream records are neighborhoods or administrative centers; this extract is not a legal municipal-status classification.
Known obvious mapping errors were corrected, but all 4,000+ mappings were not individually verified against government gazetteers.
Locations not in this snapshot cannot be selected in a strict selector; show clear no-results guidance and provide a contact route.
The data does not imply franchise availability or territory exclusivity.
Future refreshes should reapply documented fixes rather than overwrite them blindly.
